title: TraceQA findings
description: findings.json: automated checks over components.json. Written by `traceqa findings`, never by `extract`. Every finding is an automated check, not a conformance claim: automated tools find only part of the accessibility problems a page has.

FindingSeverity.description: error: very likely a real problem. warning: probably a problem, check it. info: worth a look.

FindingConfidence.description: How sure the rule is that this is a real problem, apart from its severity.

FindingScope.description: target: one browser at one viewport, written next to its components.json. run: findings about the run as a whole, written in the run folder.

FindingSuppression.description: Why a finding was set aside, from the suppression file.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The entry applies through that day.

FindingCounts.description: Findings that are not suppressed, by severity.

Finding.description: One problem found by one rule in one component.

id.description: The rule, a colon and the component id, for example unnamed-control:c_9f2a41c07b3e. The same in every browser and run while the component id is. The run-level rule browsers-disagree adds the viewport: browsers-disagree:c_9f2a41c07b3e@1280x800.

rule.description: Known values: unnamed-control, weak-name-source, fake-button, small-target, covered-at-load, ambiguous-names, missing-autocomplete, browsers-disagree (run scope only).

instances.description: Keys of the instances concerned, at most 20.

evidence.description: What the rule measured. The fields depend on the rule; see docs/usage.md.

wcag.description: WCAG 2.2 success criteria the check relates to, for example 2.5.8.

FindingsFile.description: findings.json for one target (scope target) or for the run (scope run).

rulesVersion.description: Raised when a rule is added or changes what it reports.

target.description: Folder name inside the run folder. Absent when the file was computed from a components.json alone, and for scope run.

suppressed.description: Findings set aside by the suppression file, each with its reason.
